narrative.headline: 2022 Honda Civic: steering dominates the owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 874 complaints with NHTSA. Steering stands out far above everything else at 83% of all reports, and it is also tied to the most crashes (27) and injuries (9). The remaining complaints are spread thinly across driver-assist features: forward collision avoidance (8%), lane departure (8%), vehicle speed control (5%), and the electrical system (4%). No fires and no deaths are reported in any area.

issues.title: Steering
issues.blurb: By far the dominant complaint: 726 reports (83%), tied to 27 crashes and 9 injuries, the most of any area. Some owners describe the wheel vibrating at highway speed. Test the steering carefully.
